decision: run model details the README leaves open: the author is hello.uid (a reconnect continues the run, a window reload starts one); a change of op.src or op.reverts also starts a run so every run has one source; author switch and idle end a run at its own last op, checkpoint, delete, rename, replace and stop at the event time; an idle gap of exactly idle_minutes ends the run; a deletion is its own run with source delete and start_blob = end_blob = the deleted content; blob runs have kind blob, source disk, op_count 1, start_blob null for a new file; an open run is listed with open true, end_blob null and ended_at at its latest op; chars count UTF-16 units of the transformed op; ids are AUTOINCREMENT rowids sent as decimal strings; a killed hub's open runs get end_blob = the file as loaded at the next start
why: README 5.6 names the boundaries and fields but not these cases; B7 needs a delete run it can restore and a run record that says whether it is binary (field kind) and open (field open)
evidence: docs/protocol.md section 12.1 and 12.2; runs.rs tests

decision: retention keeps the newest run of every path and every open run, deletes closed runs older than keep_days then the oldest until history.db plus referenced blobs fit max_mb, deletes blob files only after the commit, and touches only <2 hex>/<sha256>.zst and its own temp names; besides start, hourly and limit changes it also runs once the history is over max_mb and a tenth of max_mb was written since the last pass
